data.narrative:
Deep Sentinel is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by David Selinger that has raised $55M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar or equivalent stages. The private peer universe includes Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech, among others.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis used the $55M total raised as a proxy for current value and applied a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $104M. Peer-median analysis examined 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations spanning $300M to $3.0B; the median across this set stands at $1.1B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in market position and investor appetite within the defense tech category.

The triangulated valuation range is $89M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $615M. The gap between stage-progression ($104M) and peer-median ($1.1B) suggests material uncertainty around Deep Sentinel's competitive positioning relative to named peers. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, customer concentration, and whether the company's technology or go-to-market capability justifies valuations clustering above $1B versus the implied $89M–$104M floor derived from capital deployed.
